name: Tattsun
source: Tattsun is the embodiment of "Seriousness" and "Discipline" (with a capital "S" and a capital "D"). As a law-abiding goody two-shoes, even if the reason is legitimate, rule breaking is rule breaking, and he will always say his piece. He longs to be a strong, upright superhero of justice with a serious personality, just like the heroes from his favorite show, "The Electro Rangers," whom he idolizes. When he sees an injustice, he'll reference the Electro Rangers, starting a long lecture and distracting everybody.
